verdicts.reason: A: the skates are cropped. A row of circles and the divider lines have been laid straight across the skate boot, which reads as a glitch. The "LINK IN BIO" label is pushed to the right edge of its button with dead space on the left, and the offer copy is jammed against the right edge while the lower left of the canvas sits empty. B: the skates are also cropped, and the arrow now cuts across the skate blade. The offer block is jumbled: "XMASRINK" is stranded below and to the left of "USE CODE", and "50% OFF" is tiny and out of line with the rest. Even so, B keeps the headline and CTA hierarchy and a more balanced, original-like feel, so it is the less bad of the two.
